Subject: Supplier registration: staged document handoff & PO enablement plan

Samantha —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the supplier setup with Redwood. I’m Chloe on Procurement and I’ll be your primary contact to get AcmeTech added to our AP system and ready to receive POs. Below is a short, staged checklist so we can track progress and hit the target PO activation date of 2026-03-25.

Stage 1 — Required docs (please return within 3 business days):
- Signed Supplier Registration Form (attached: Supplier_Registration_Form.xlsx) — basic company + remittance info;
- US tax form: W-9 (if AcmeTech is US) OR W-8BEN-E (if non-US) — PDF preferred;
- Bank details (bank letter or voided check) for ACH setup;
- VAT certificate (EU suppliers only) or VAT registration number if applicable.

Stage 2 — Procurement validation (internal, 2 business days):
- Procurement confirms tax form and vendor classification;
- Finance verifies bank details and EIN;
- Legal runs quick T&Cs check (we’ll only require the standard PO terms for first engagements).

Stage 3 — PO enablement (internal/external, 1–2 business days):
- We create vendor record and issue a test PO (small-dollar).
- Once invoice is validated, the vendor is marked active for normal POs.

Attachments / links:
- Supplier_Registration_Form.xlsx (attached) — please complete and return;
- If you prefer DocuSign, we can send the form that way — say the word.

Questions for you:
1) Is AcmeTech registered in the US (EIN) or outside the US? If US, please attach a filled W-9. If outside, W-8BEN-E and VAT details where relevant.
2) Are invoices remitted via AP email (ap@acmetech.com) or a vendor portal? If portal, please share admin contact.

Target dates: receipt of docs by 2026-03-17 -> internal validation by 2026-03-19 -> PO live by 2026-03-25. If any of these look tight on your side, tell me which items might slip and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — look forward to getting you onboarded.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the W-9. To answer your questions:
- Test PO amount: we generally issue a token PO between $250–$500 (depends on the commodity). The purpose is purely to validate invoice routing and payment method.
- Additional signatures: not for standard commodity purchases. If we later require a Master Services Agreement, Legal will reach out; for now the completed Supplier Registration Form plus tax and bank docs are sufficient.

Requesting the following to keep our timeline:
1) Please return the completed Supplier_Registration_Form.xlsx by EOD Monday (2026-03-16).
2) Confirm whether bank_letter.pdf can be shared via email or must be uploaded to your vendor portal. If email is okay, please attach the bank letter to your reply.

I’ve attached a short PO_Terms_Quickguide.pdf that shows our payment terms and invoice requirements (helpful for your AP team). Marcus will pick up finance verification once we have the W-9 and bank letter.

Thanks again — I’ll watch for your form and bank letter.

Best,
Chloe
